values.Speaker: Narrator

values.Speaker: Narrator
values.Text: Well, one reason is: the greenhouse effect! A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and a glass roof.

values.Text: In the daytime, the Sun shines through the atmosphere warming Earth’s surface. After the Sun goes down, Earth’s surface cools.

values.Speaker: Narrator
values.Text: This releases heat back into the air. But, some of that heat is trapped by the gases in the atmosphere.
